svg.title: Multi-agent architecture organized into three response lanes
svg.desc: User talks to the Orchestrator agent which classifies intent into three lanes: known theme replies are answered directly, FAQ questions go to the FAQ agent with RAG knowledge, and booking requests go to the Booking agent which delegates to Slot Check and Implementation sub-agents. Slot Check and Implementation both reach external services through MCP.

g.text: Detects intent and routes the query

svg.text: Confirmation flows back to the orchestrator, which replies to the user
· Solid arrows are runtime calls. Dashed lines attach an agent to its LLM or knowledge base.
· Gray circles are external services reached through MCP — calendar reads, email, sheets, docs.
· The orchestrator picks one of three lanes per query — only one runs at a time.
· Lane 1 is the early-exit shortcut for issues already flagged in the themes knowledge base.
· If the user asks for a human or seems unsatisfied mid-conversation, the orchestrator switches to lane 3.
· Booking only proceeds to the implementation agent if the slot check agent reports the slot is free.
